gioco: The Legend of Zelda
nota: It is set in the fantasy land of Hyrule and centers on an elf-like boy named Link, who aims to collect the eight fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom to rescue Princess Zelda from Ganon.

gioco: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
nota: The Adventure of Link is a direct sequel to the original The Legend of Zelda, again involving the protagonist Link, on a quest to save Princess Zelda, who has fallen under a sleeping spell.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
nota: Before the events of the game, the descendants of the Seven Sages who imprisoned Ganon are captured, Princess Zelda included, and, one by one, sent to the Dark World.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
nota: Link also meets Princess Zelda, who is under the watch of her Sheikah caretaker, Impa, and encounters the King of the Gerudo, Ganondorf.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords
nota: After Zelda explains its history and the evil sorcerer sealed within it, the sorcerer named Vaati breaks free, capturing Zelda to marry her.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker
nota: Aided by allies including pirate captain Tetra – an incarnation of Princess Zelda – and a talking sailboat named the King of Red Lions, Link sails the ocean, explores islands, and traverses dungeons to acquire the power necessary to defeat Ganon.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Adventures
nota: === Story === Fearing that Vaati's seal is weakening, which has caused strange happenings through Hyrule, Princess Zelda summons Link as a guard while she and the Shrine Maidens open the portal to the Four Sword Sanctuary.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
nota: In the present, Link accompanies his childhood friend Princess Zelda to the Picori Festival to deliver a sword for the sword fighting champion who gets to touch the Picori Sword.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
nota: She guides him to Princess Zelda, who explains that Zant, the usurper king of the Twili, invaded Hyrule Castle and forced her to surrender.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass
nota: Link's journey to save his friend Tetra from the story's primary antagonist, Bellum (Tetra è l'incarnazione di Zelda: "pirate captain Tetra – an incarnation of Princess Zelda", pagina di The Wind Waker)

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks
nota: Set a century after the events of Phantom Hourglass, the storyline follows a new Link and the great-great-granddaughter of Tetra, Princess Zelda, as they explore the land of New Hyrule to prevent the awakening of the Demon King Malladus.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword
nota: The series main protagonist Link, a resident of a floating town called Skyloft, sets out to rescue his childhood friend Zelda after she is kidnapped and brought to the abandoned lands below the clouds.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
nota: Players assume the role of Link, who sets out to restore peace to the kingdom of Hyrule after the evil sorcerer Yuga captures Princess Zelda and escapes through a rift into the parallel world of Lorule.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
nota: Set near the end of the Zelda timeline, it follows Link as he sets out to save Princess Zelda and prevent Calamity Ganon from destroying the world.

gioco: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
nota: The player controls Link as he searches for Princess Zelda and fights to prevent Ganondorf from destroying Hyrule.
